description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git's cherry-pick and rerere functionality, including conflict resolution and auto-update behaviors.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Performs a test commit with the specified message and files.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Runs a test expecting success with a given description.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a test expecting a command to fail.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares files to ensure they are identical.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets a configuration variable for the test.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.

methods.name: test_abort
methods.description: Aborts the current test or operation.
